title: H3Fusion: Helpful, Harmless, Honest Fusion of Aligned LLMs
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. The benchmarks focused on general helpfulness (Alpaca-Eval), harmlessness/safety against 14 harm categories (BeaverTails), and honesty/truthfulness (TruthfulQA).
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith.
